home.tagline: Spin for a team and an era, draft {size} players, and chase the perfect 82-0 season.
home.attribution: Stats derived from the <link>NBA Stats (1947–present)</link> dataset by Sumitro Datta (CC BY-SA 4.0). Not affiliated with the NBA.

spin.title: Spin
spin.body: Spin for a random team and era. The same team-era combo never comes up twice.

reSpins.title: Re-spins
reSpins.body: {teamSkips} Team re-spin and {eraSkips} Era re-spin. A re-spin rolls only that axis.

pick.title: Pick
pick.body: Tap a player, then one of their positions. Starters need a PG, SG, SF, PF, C. Bench needs a G, a F, and C.

optimize.title: Optimize
optimize.body: You can rearrange drafted players between eligible slots any time during the draft.

simulate.title: Simulate
simulate.body: Your team is era-adjusted and runs a full season. One weakness can cap your wins.

budget.title: Budget Draft
budget.subtitle: Draft under a salary cap
budget.intro: Pick a difficulty, draft 6 players under the salary cap, then challenge historic teams head-to-head.
budget.howPricing: Prices reflect each player's era-adjusted performance ($5–$35).
budget.budgetExceeded: Budget exceeded — the server rejected this roster.
